name: 5619-batchdecode-dsv25fp8-tp8
model: A locally produced 128x128 block-wise FP8 copy of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2.5-1210, converted from the bf16 release because no block-wise FP8 build of this model is published. 236.9 GB over 164 shards, 29.6 GB per card at TP8. A local path rather than a Hub id -- see `model-path` in sglang-config.yaml.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=8, PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier. EP is a REQUIREMENT of this checkpoint at this topology and not a performance choice: block-wise FP8 needs each expert's gate/up width to be a multiple of the 128-wide scale block, and a plain TP8 split of moe_intermediate_size 1536 gives 192, which the engine refuses at weight creation.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 60 layers of which the first is dense and 59 are MoE. MLA attention, hidden 5120, intermediate 12288, vocab 102400, 160 routed experts + 2 shared, top-6 over 8 groups, moe_intermediate_size 1536, YaRN to 163840 positions. Block-wise FP8 weights with weight_block_size [128, 128] and dynamic activation scaling; norms, embeddings, the MoE gate and lm_head stay bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 320 requests with an 1800 s safety cap -- ten rounds of 32, of which ~240 are scored. Keep any load search near 32 streams; outside it this is no longer the operating point the item is declared over.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix: exactly 512 prompt tokens and exactly 512 generated tokens, no spread. Output length is pinned with `ignore_eos`, which guidellm 0.7.3 sends whenever output_tokens is declared and this engine's OpenAI adapters forward at this commit. Seed 42.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a large mixture-of-experts model, serving 32 concurrent half-page prompts and replies across eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang launch arguments. Flat `key: value` only -- the parser skips indented lines, and a
# dropped line is an engine running without the argument this file declares.

# A LOCAL PATH, not a Hub id: this checkpoint is produced on this machine, see configs/env.yaml.
model-path: ${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/DeepSeek-V2.5-1210-blockfp8
tp-size: 8

# MANDATORY, not a tuning knob. Block-wise FP8 requires each expert's gate/up output width to be
# a multiple of the 128-wide scale block; moe_intermediate_size is 1536, so a plain TP8 split
# gives 192 and `Fp8MoEMethod.create_weights` raises a ValueError -- the server does not start.
# Expert parallelism gives each rank 20 whole experts, so the width stays 1536 and divides.
enable-ep-moe: true

attention-backend: fa3
disable-radix-cache: true

# The checkpoint ships `auto_map` and its own configuration module.
trust-remote-code: true

# MANDATORY, not a tuning knob. The checkpoint advertises 163840 positions and the
# request-to-token pool is allocated eagerly as (max_num_reqs+1) x (context_length+4) int32 on
# the device, OUTSIDE mem-fraction-static; at the advertised window that is terabytes and the
# server never starts. 8192 is far above this workload's longest request (512 + 512).
context-length: 8192
